pages.title: Omnicellular Genome
pages.text: One genome that can build any creature in any dimension - carbon or silicon, DNA or not. It is a coiled, shifting helix that seems to change alphabet as I watch. Every living thing I have met is a sentence it can write.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)I fed the Evolution Engine a panspermia seed, a silicon life spore, a neural organoid, recombinant DNA and Xenoplasm and let it evolve a single code that could express all of them. It took less time than I feared.
Made in $(item)Evolution Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Panspermia.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Arbor Simulacrum, Bubble Universe, Omnilex Seal, Pocket Universe, Transfinite Lattice Bolt.
